parallel.requirements: Parallel recognized the task's ESM, .mjs, zero dependency, argparse, and whoosh Schema output requirements and captured byte-level executable behavior before delegating.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It launched one workflow with phased ownership: spec children first, then implement, integrate, verify, repair, and critic phases. Implementation was owned in the script but gated behind completed specs.
parallel.implementation: No implementation files were produced. The run reached only probing and spec work; the implementation phase never completed or visibly launched in the final workspace.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integration and delivery were planned but never reached. Artifact validation found an empty artifact directory and no expected test2.mjs.
parallel.verification: The parent and children probed the executable, but there was no final Node artifact to verify; official evaluation recorded 0 of 163.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The whoosh spec child was repeatedly retried and remained unfinished; after the workflow was killed the parent did not take over enough work to deliver any file.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same task requirements, including command-line byte behavior, whoosh Schema output, ESM modules, .mjs suffixes, and zero external dependencies.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Serial kept ownership in one process without delegation, moving from probing to module implementation, entrypoint assembly, differential tests, and final response.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote an argparse layer, Python-like helpers, whoosh modules, test2.mjs, and test harness files under /output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial integrated the modules into the entrypoint, delivered an artifact tree containing test2.mjs and library files, and returned a final summary.
serial.verification: Serial ran differential checks, stream checks, width checks, and library self-tests, reporting 37/37 differential cases and 51/51 library tests.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still marked solution_passed false at 104 of 163, so remaining semantic gaps likely existed despite the delivered artifact and self-tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt obligations and embedded many of them into the workflow script before delegating.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same obligations and later reflected them in its delivered tree and final verification notes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was broadly similar; the material difference was not understanding but whether recognized requirements were converted into delivered files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into a workflow with separate spec children and downstream implement, integrate, verify, and repair owners gated after the spec phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained one owner for the whole path and performed probing, writing, fixing, and verifying directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's ownership existed but was phase-gated and stalled in child retry; serial avoided cross-agent ownership handoff and kept forward progress local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The initial child briefs contained rich task context, but repeated whoosh retries did not receive an accumulated checkpoint from earlier attempts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated executable observations and implementation state in one trajectory and used those findings during later edits and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost continuity across retry boundaries, while serial preserved context by not replacing the worker.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel never wrote the requested Node migration artifact to /output and never reached visible implementation completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the entrypoint, argparse layer, Python helpers, whoosh modules, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main implementation difference is absolute: serial created a partial port, while parallel delivered no code artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The argparse child returned a result, but the whoosh child chain stalled through retries; the parent stopped the workflow and never produced an aggregate deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle and closed with a final summary after local verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's delegated result lifecycle broke before implementation; serial had no handoff to retrieve or abandon.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned integration after component implementation but never created shared /output files, so no merge collision occurred.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated its modules into an artifact tree with test2.mjs and supporting libraries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The shared-state difference is missing production in parallel versus a coherent though imperfect serial output tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probed executable behavior but had no implemented Node artifact for integrated differential verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran differential, stream, help-width, and library tests and reported their passing local results before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial performed artifact-level verification; parallel only did pre-implementation probing and then official evaluation of an empty artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full cell budget, returned 143, was marked timed out, and had 249436 workflow-child tokens without a deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed with returncode 0, no timeout, and remaining budget, despite still failing the official pass threshold.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was budget exhaustion after a killed workflow; serial closure was normal completion with an imperfect but present artifact.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official completed status records both solutions as not passed. The important process difference is still large: parallel returned no artifact and scored 0 of 163 after a killed workflow, while serial delivered a tested artifact tree and scored 104 of 163 but still below the official pass threshold.
parallel_contributors: Workflow spec retries repeated without inherited checkpoints and consumed the window before implementation.
After the stalled workflow was stopped, the parent did not take over or reassign the unfinished whoosh and implementation work.
serial_contributors: The serial attempt kept requirements, observations, edits, and verification in one continuous trajectory.
The serial attempt produced /output/test2.mjs and supporting .mjs library files before final verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still failed the official pass threshold at 104 of 163, so remaining semantic defects in the delivered port are ordinary implementation quality gaps rather than parallel coordination labels.
Parallel had no implementation artifact, so its official zero score is not explained by a subtle coding defect.
evaluator_effects: No official retry supersedes these current status evaluations; serial artifact_ok true does not change solution_passed false.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors for a material score and artifact difference, not an exclusive root cause and not an official pass/fail discordance
